newsitem.title: USA: American International Q1 life premium up.
newsitem.headline: American International Q1 life premium up.

text.p: American International Group Inc said first quarter life premium income rose 12.7 percent to $2.30 billion.
Before the impact of foreign exchange, premium income rose 16.3 percent, American International said.
American International said its worldwide life insurance operations reported first quarter 1997 pretax income before realized capital gains of $346 million, up 22.3 percent from a year ago.
AIG Chairman Maurice Greenberg said, "Asia, AIG's largest life insurance market, reported excellent results, while our foreign life business outside Asia is also growing strongly."
AIG said its domestic life insurance companies reported operating income up 20.1 percent in the first quarter.
"Ordinary life premiums and U.S. pension premiums were both especially strong," Greenberg said.

"AIG's growing consumer finance activities, reported through our Life Division, also made progress in the quarter, as we pursue a number of opportunities in markets where AIG already has a strong insurance presence," he said.
